data.description:
Implement the prepare-commit-msg hook that surfaces the override reason in git log.

## Implementation logic
1. source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/deps.sh
2. ARTIFACTS_DIR=$(get_artifacts_dir)
3. TOKEN_FILE="$ARTIFACTS_DIR/override.token"
4. If TOKEN_FILE does not exist, exit 0 (no-op)
5. Extract reason field from TOKEN_FILE (jq or grep-based JSON parse)
6. Append 'Override-Reason: <reason>' as a git trailer to $1 (the commit message file)
7. exit 0

## Post-implementation
chmod +x plugins/dso/hooks/prepare-commit-msg-override-audit.sh

## Classification
GREEN — implement to make T3b tests pass

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/hooks/prepare-commit-msg-override-audit.sh (CREATE)
